frontDevelopmentPhase.title: Orchestration tardive et suivi workflows
frontDevelopmentPhase.goal: Ajouter le front de suivi des workflows seulement une fois les flux metier stabilises.

allowedMocksUntilDependenciesExist.item: Before this phase, end-to-end tests drive services directly through their public APIs.
When orchestration arrives, reuse the same scenarios and assert workflow state/idempotence.

frontTests.item: Existing vertical-flow tests still pass with orchestration enabled.
Workflow status displays completed, pending and failed steps.
Retry action is available only to authorized admin roles.
Duplicate workflow start is idempotent where required.

apiGatewayImpact.item: Route /workflows only after orchestration-service is intentionally introduced.
Do not make earlier front phases depend on /workflows.

definitionOfDone.item: Orchestration is observable, not a hidden dependency of early front development.
Previous service-level and front E2E tests remain valid.

frontDevelopmentPhase.workingRule: Developper par tranche verticale: API minimale reelle, ecran utilisable, tests front, verification navigateur, puis phase suivante.
